```artifact
Feature: Patient Management and Medicine Delivery

  Scenario: Medicines are delivered as prescribed by the doctor (offline)
    Given the doctor has prescribed medicines for a patient
    When the system processes the prescription offline
    Then the medicines should be delivered as per the doctor's prescription

  Scenario: Register a new Patient
    Given the system is ready to accept new patient registrations
    When a new patient details are provided
    Then the patient should be successfully registered in the system

  Scenario Outline: View and Update the details of an existing Patient
    Given the patient with ID <patient_id> exists in the system
    When the patient details are updated with <new_details>
    Then the patient details should be updated to <new_details>
    Examples:
      | patient_id | new_details                |
      | 12345      | {"name": "John Doe", "age": 30} |
      | 67890      | {"name": "Jane Smith", "age": 25} |

  Scenario Outline: Delete the Patient Details - A Patient cannot be deleted if there is one or more Consultation Requests in last 3 years
    Given the patient with ID <patient_id> has consultation requests in the last <years> years
    When the system attempts to delete the patient details
    Then the system should not delete the patient details and should return an error message "<error_message>"
    Examples:
      | patient_id | years | error_message |
      | 12345      | 2     | "Cannot delete patient with recent consultation requests." |
      | 67890      | 3     | "Cannot delete patient with recent consultation requests." |

  Scenario: There will be a provision to rollback by a month
    Given the system has a backup of the database
    When the rollback operation is initiated
    Then the system should revert to the state of the database one month ago

  Scenario: The back-up shall be restored on a dummy production system to ensure completeness and correctness of back-up
    Given the system has a backup of the database
    When the backup is restored on a dummy production system
    Then the dummy production system should have the same data as the backup

  Scenario: The dummy production database shall be purged
    Given the dummy production system has data
    When the purging operation is initiated
    Then the dummy production database should be empty

  Scenario: It will be maintained in Mangalore HQ in a fire proof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital
    Given the system has a backup of the database
    When the backup is stored
    Then the backup should be stored in Mangalore HQ in a fire proof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital
```
